positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Web application development using Java (including Spring and Struts 2), JavaScript (including jQuery), responsive CSS (including Foundation and Bootstrap), and SQL (including PL/SQL).
-	Analysis of legacy data systems to detect deprecated technologies and areas of limited capability
-	Collaborate with customers to identify deficiencies in existing systems and design feasible solutions
-	Extensive planning to implement system upgrades/enhancements with no disruption or downtime
-	Use of analytical tools to log and report performance metrics and quantify success of upgrades
-	Supervision of supporting developers

positions.title: Network / AIX Server Administrator
positions.description:
UNIX/FTP Server Administration
- Administration of UNIX-based server systems, including IBM AIX and Red Hat.
- Task automation and information gathering using shell scripts.
- System backup, restoration, and monitoring using IBM Tivoli products.

Network Administration
- Planning, coordinating, and documenting efforts to implement new data systems.
- Reconfiguration and troubleshooting of network/server cabling and connections.
- Installation and maintenance of infrastructure network cabling.
